Bill.BriefDescription: Creating an identity theft unit within the Washington state patrol.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the creation of an identity theft unit withinthe Washington state patrol; adding a new section to chapter 43.43 RCW;and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An identity theft unit is created in the Washington statepatrol, which shall be under the direction of the chief of theWashington state patrol. (2) The identity theft unit shall investigate all identity theftcases and any identity theft case that may be in relation to, but isnot limited to, theft, forgery, cyber crimes, fraud, or criminalimpersonation. (3) The identity theft unit shall study and develop a plan for aneffective statewide unit for identity theft to be funded in the 20092011 biennium. The identity theft unit shall report its findings andrecommendations to the legislature by December 31, 2008. (4) The identity theft unit shall be organized at the discretion ofthe chief of the Washington state patrol. p. 1 HB 3045 (5) The identity theft unit shall be comprised of a total of fourstate patrol officers dedicated to work identity theft cases. (6) The identity theft unit shall assist local jurisdictions in theinvestigation of identity theft crimes under subsection (2) of thissection that cross existing jurisdictional lines or that requirespecialized technical skills.

The sum of three hundred thousand dollars,or as much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscalyear ending June 30, 2009, from the general fund to the Washingtonstate patrol for purposes of implementing this act.
